d: In the 1990s, the financial and social hub of Appalachia was a mix of intellectuals, college football stars, and good ol' boys with a hankerin' for big city livin'.
Anjette Lyles was a beloved Macon restaurateur, twice widowed, a mother--and almost the first white woman electrocuted in Georgia.
One of the wealthiest doctors in Arkansas finds trouble when she meets a ruthless con man who convinces her to give him more that a million dollars. Narrated by Paul Winfield.

st: San Francisco: Betrayal By The Sea
d: Shots rang out into the cool San Francisco night. It was fall, 1991 and Artie Mitchell lay on the floor dying. His girlfriend frantically called 911 as his brother stood over him with the muder weapon in his hand.
The story of one of the most shocking crimes in modern American history--the murders of five members of the Communist Workers' Party by Ku Klux Klansmen and American Nazis in 1979.

After six members of the DeFeo family are murdered in their home in Amityville, New York, by the oldest DeFeo son, George and Kathy Lutz move into the house and claim to experience a series of bizarre, supernatural events.
A police arson investigator is suspected of strangling his wife to death and then setting her body on fire to cover up the crime. Paul Winfield narrates.

Terri Gilbert, a prominent health care consultant, claims self-defense after shooting and killing her philandering husband Gene, a leading attorney. The trial rocks the City of Albuquerque and leads to a surprise verdict. Paul Winfield narrates.

Boston, MA. The lazy Charles River curves through this old town of universities, banks and insurance companies. One of the oldest cities in the country, Boston has always prided itself on its sophistication and its tolerance.

In 1983, two bankers were murdered on a secluded Minnesota farm. Their deaths and the lives of their troubled killers shocked the small town of Ruthton and became a disputed national symbol for the farm crisis of the early 1980s.

Apple Creek is an Amish Country village that's a throwback to another time. When a young mother of five is found shot to death in her home, an investigation is launched, and a private community finds itself at the center of a murder case.
Two former California cops go into business in the City of Angels' sleazy adult entertainment industry. But their partnership ends in a murder.

st: Sunny Days, Deadly Nights On Mercer Island
d: A woman's naked body is found outside a Seattle nightclub, posed demurely with a pinecone in her hand. Narrated by Paul Winfield.

A centuries-old inn that once hosted George Washington and Ben Franklin becomes the site of a shocking crime when world-class chef Jim Webb is murdered and fellow chef Guy Sileo becomes the chief suspect.
Story of the murder that ruined Bermuda's reputation as the "safest place in the world." In 1996, 17-year-old Canadian tourist Rebecca Middleton was killed--and her presumed murderer walked free.

In December 1986, a young college student was found murdered off a remote highway overpass in San Diego. The thought of a killer roaming the freeways of Southern California's sun-drenched urban paradise had female drivers in the area wrought with fear.

st: Elizabeth, NJ: Death of a Don
d: A look at the DeCavalcante crime family, which ruled the gritty port city of Elizabeth and resembled the "The Sopranos" of TV fame.

st: Phoenix: Shady Deals in Sun City
d: When a printer refuses to go along with his partner's plans to do business with the mob, the printer is murdered in a contract killing and investigators charge the partner's wife.

On a warm, clear night in the desert near Lake Mead, the body of a man--shot dead--was found in the middle of the road. When Las Vegas Metro homicide detectives began investigating the death, they had no idea the case would lead them to a conspiracy.
